purpose: Teach: 仰せ/平家/国際線/保養/切り離さ/造語/部外/三越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教員の仰せに従え
lines.en: Ren — follow what your advisor tells you.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause before the name. Not unkind, but the tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. Weight on the instruction itself, not performing authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。平家物語の栄枯研究も興味あります
lines.en: Yes. I'm interested in that research on the rise and fall of the Heike too.
lines.style: Eager to show understanding, leaning slightly forward in the voice. Earnest without overperforming. Small acknowledgment in the 'yes' — ready to listen and already engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、国際線で海外学会に行け
lines.en: Ren — go to the international conference. Take the overseas flight.
lines.style: Clear, specific instruction. Pauses between clauses like ticking items on a list. Not negotiable, but said as plainly as a weather report. Ren will understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教員の保養休暇も理解します
lines.en: Yes. I understand — you need that time away too.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment at the start. Slight warmth on the second part — careful, respectful recognition of something unstated. Not presuming, just observing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、無関係なデータを切り離さない姿勢も時に必要だ
lines.en: Ren — sometimes you need to hold onto the pieces that don't seem to fit. Don't be too quick to cut things away.
lines.style: Slower delivery than the directives. This is mentor-wisdom, not instruction. Slight breath before 'sometimes.' Ren's listening carefully, so Hiroshi takes a moment to be precise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術造語の使い方に気を付けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll be more careful with how I use the academic terminology.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Processing — he's taking this seriously. Even pace. Finishes cleanly, not defensive, just confirming he's heard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、部外者には研究機密を見せるな
lines.en: Ren — don't show your research to people outside the lab. Keep the work secure.
lines.style: Firmest of all the directives. This one has teeth. Measured, not harsh — but Hiroshi means this. A beat of emphasis on 'don't,' and the reasoning is clear in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。三越本店の文化講座にも参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful about that.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Shorter, more closed. Not reluctant — just the signal that he's heard and accepted. Small settling-down quality, like closing a notebook.
